ValidationRule.description: Employer City and Employer Address are required when Employment Status is 'Employed'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Jordan"), ISPICKVAL(Employment_Status__c, "Employed"), OR( ISBLANK(Employer_City__c), ISBLANK(Employer_Address__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Employer City and Employer Address are required when Employment Status is 'Employed'.
